note: The surface form is can be reflexive or reciprocal; sentence context must determine the interpretation. Do not assign one meaning globally.
Project review confirms reciprocal is in this construction.
SLS describes la as impersonal. Exact syntactic interpretation can depend on the construction, so retain it as context-sensitive rather than labeling every la sentence passive.
Keep la and idin as separate grammatical roles. idin is the second-person-plural object and must not be treated as the agreement controller.

gloss_en: Can you guys be seen? / Is it possible to see you guys?
note: Ability/possibility is part of the construction; do not reduce the sentence to a simple la + object pattern.
